scope: Windows producer ZIP pre-allocation guard only; owner retains safe path, CRC, manifest, payload and signature checks
semantics: ordinary single-disk non-ZIP64 ZIP; EOCD is the final EOCD signature in last 65557 bytes and its comment ends exactly at EOF; reject ZIP64 EOCD/locator signatures inside the archive comment
check declared entry/central-byte limits before allocating an entry collection; exactly the declared central records fill centralOffset..EOCD
parse only bounded fixed headers/names/extras; reject ZIP64 fields/extra, disk mismatch, truncated ranges and central/local name/flag/method disagreement
ordinary local records including optional 12/16-byte data descriptors cover offset zero through centralOffset with no overlap, prefix, gaps or hidden records
empty ordinary ZIP supported by guard; owning Windows payload contract requires its own mandatory entries
